translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Hachche Hachche Shiishshiyaa Yarshshuwaa
Med'inaa Goday Musa,
«Israa'eelatuwaa hawaadan yaagaade azaza; ‹Ta k'umaa, taana toshukku giide sawana mala, taman yarshshiyaa ta yarshshuwaa keereedda wodiyaan wodiyaan taw naagiide immite› yaaga.
K'ay neeni unttuntta, ‹Med'inaa Godaw taman yarshshiyaa yarshshuu hawaa: tilla bollana de'iyaa, itti laytsaa gideedda laa"u dorssaa orggetuwaa hachchi hachchi s'uuggiyaa yarshshoo yarshshite;
dorssaa orggetuwaappe ittuwaa wontta, laa"entsuwaa omarssi yarshshite.
K'ay hewaana itti liitiro gidiyaa zayitiyaan munak'etteedda itti kiilo giraame muruta zarggaa d'iiliyaa katsaa yarshshoo yarshshite.
Hawe Med'inaa Godaa toshukku giide sawana mala, Siinaa Deriyaa bollan azazetteedda, hachchi hachchi taman s'uuggiyaa yarshshuwaa.
Hewaana yarshshiyaa ushshaa yarshshuu itti dorssaa orggiyaw itti liitiro gidiyaa woyniyaa eessaa. Ushshaa yarshshuwaa Geeshsha Sa'aan Med'inaa Godaw gussite.
Omarssi laa"entso dorssaa orggiyaa, wonttawaa ootseeddawaadan ootsiide, katsaa yarshshuwaananne ushshaa yarshshuwaanna Med'inaa Godaa toshukku giide sawana mala, taman yarshshite.
Sambbata Gallassaa Yarshshuwaa

« ‹Sambbata gallassan, tilla bollana de'iyaa itti laytsaa gideedda laa"u dorssaanne zayitiyaan munak'etteedda laa"u kiilo giraame gidiyaa muruta d'iiliyaa katsaa yarshshuwaanne ushshaa yarshshuwaa ootsiide yarshshite.
Hachche hachchi s'uuggiyaa yarshshuwaanne Aa ushshaa yarshshuwaa bolla, Sambbata gallassaa ubbaan hintte yarshshiyaa s'uuggiyaa yarshshuu hawaa.
Aginay S'eeriya Gallassaa Yarshshuwaa

« ‹Aginay s'eeriya gallassaa ubbaan, laa"u korumatuwaa, itti dorssaa orggiyaanne itti laytsaa gideedda laappun dorssaa orggetuwaa, ubbaykka tilla bollana de'iyaawantta, s'uuggiyaa yarshshuwaa ootsiide, Med'inaa Godaw yarshshite.

Itti itti korumaanna zayitiyaan munak'etteedda heezzu kiilo giraame gidiyaa muruta zarggaa d'iiliyaa, itti dorssaa orggiyaana zayitiyaan munak'etteedda laa"u kiilo giraame gidiyaa muruta zarggaa d'iiliyaanne

laappun dorssaa maratuwaappe itti itti dorssaa maraanna zayitiyaan munak'etteedda itti kiilo giraame gidiyaa muruta zarggaa d'iiliyaa katsaa yarshshuwaa ootsiide, Med'inaa Godaa toshukku giide sawana mala, taman yarshshiyaa yarshshuwaa yarshshite.

K'ay ushshaa yarshshoo itti itti korumaanna laa"u liitiro gidiyaa woyniyaa eessaa, itti dorssaa orggiyaana itti liitironne bagga woyniyaa eessaanne itti itti dorssaa maraanna itti liitiro gidiyaa woyniyaa eessaa shiishshite. Hawe laytsaa giddon aginay s'eeriya gallassaa ubbaan yarshshiyaa s'uuggiyaa yarshshuwaa.
Hachche hachchi s'uuggiyaa yarshshuwaanne Aa ushshaa yarshshuwaa bolla, itti deeshshaa orggiyaa nagaraa yarshshuwaa ootsiide, Med'inaa Godaw yarshshite.
Paasigaa Baalaanne Ukitsaa Baalaa Yarshshotuwaa
« ‹Koyiro aginaan tammanne oyddentso gallassay Med'inaa Godaa Paasigaa bonchchiyaa gallassaa gido.
K'ay he aginankka tammanne ichcheshentso gallassan doommiide, Ukitsaa Baalay bonchchetee; hewaa diraw, laappun gallassatuwaan irshshuu gelibeenna ukitsaa miite.
He gallassatuwaappe koyiro gallassan geeshsha shiik'uwaa shiik'ite; daaburssiyaa ooso ayaanne ootsoppite.
Laa"u korumatuwaa, itti dorssaa orggiyaanne itti laytsaa gideedda laappun dorssaa orggetuwaa, ubbaykka tilla bollana de'iyaawantta, taman yarshshiyaa yarshshuwaa ootsiide, Med'inaa Godaw yarshshite.
Katsaa yarshshoo itti korumaanna zayitiyaan munak'etteedda heezzu kiilo giraame gidiyaa muruta zarggaa d'iiliyaa, itti dorssaa orggiyaana laa"u kiilo giraame gidiyaa d'iiliyaanne
laappun dorssaa maratuwaappe itti itti maraanna itti kiilo giraame d'iiliyaa yarshshite.
K'ay itti deeshshaa orggiyaa nagaraa yarshshoo, hintte nagaraa atto giissanaw yarshshite.

Hachche hachchi wontta s'uuggiyaa yarshshuwaanne Aa katsaa yarshshuwaa bolla, sawuwaa toshukku giyaa k'umaa taman yarshshiyaa yarshshuwaa gujjiide, Med'inaa Godaw yarshshite. Laappun gallassaw hewaadan ootsite.
Laappuntsa gallassan k'ay geeshsha shiik'uwaa shiik'ite; daaburssiyaa ooso ayaanne ootsoppite.
Saaminttatuwaa Baalaa Yarshshuwaa
« ‹Saaminttatu Baalaa gallassan hintte Med'inaa Godaw ooratsa katsaa shiishshiyaa wode, geeshsha shiik'uwaa shiik'ite; daaburssiyaa ooso ayaanne ootsoppite.
Laa"u korumatuwaa, itti dorssaa orggiyaanne itti laytsaa gideedda laappun dorssaa orggetuwaa sawuwaa toshukku giyaa s'uuggiyaa yarshshuwaa ootsiide, Med'inaa Godaw yarshshite.
Itti itti korumaanna zayitiyaan munak'etteedda heezzu kiilo giraame gidiyaa muruta zarggaa d'iiliyaa, itti dorssaa orggiyaana laa"u kiilo giraame d'iiliyaanne
laappun dorssaa maratuwaappe itti itti maraanna itti kiilo giraame d'iiliyaa katsaa yarshshoo yarshshite.
K'ay itti deeshshaa orggiyaa nagaraa atto giissiyaa yarshshuwaa ootsiide yarshshite.
Hachche hachchi s'uuggiyaa yarshshuwaanne Aa ushshaa yarshshuwaa bolla, hawantta unttunttu katsaa yarshshuwaanna yarshshite. Mehetuu tilla bollana de'iyaawantta gidiyaawaa geeshshiide erite.
